children: may climb to 4,372 ringgit per metric ton, the peak of a wave b.
The market bounced strongly around the November 10 low of 4,088 ringgit. The bounce suggests the formation of a double-bottom or a wedge, both of which signal a further bounce.

The fall from 4,577 ringgit consists of three waves. The peak of the second wave, the wave b, serves as a target. On the daily chart, a bullish engulfing pattern formed between Monday and Tuesday, confirming a completion of the short downtrend from 4,578 ringgit.
The market is biased to climb towards the upper channel line around 4,424 ringgit.
